what: Cases found by the random runs (properties, metamorphic, the nightly), each with the seed and the reason, kept for ever. pairs.test.js runs every one through checkAnswer. Shape: { name, inputs, env?: { futures, seed }, expect?: { 'dotted.key': value }, found: { date, by, seed } }. A finding of a relation between two answers is kept as its two households, one after the other, under the same seed (properties.test.js replays them).
